title: keteleeria davidiana var. pubescens
intro: Keteleeria davidiana var. pubescens, commonly known as the 'pubescent keteleeria', is a plant species within the cypress family (Cupressaceae). It is a deciduous coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of China. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Keteleeria davidiana var. pubescens include terpenoids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-arthritic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, providing relief from respiratory issues and joint pain.
